status_note: The five covered cases require byte-identical locked-oracle records for BlockGraph::newBlockCopy/buildCopy edge-vector and state copying, append-only suffix remapping, source copymap writes, selected live BlockCopy delegation through a complete custom Basic probe, legal BlockBasic end insertion with SeqNum order/parent/SWITCH_OUT mutation, and reciprocal parallel-edge deletion after a legal BlockBasic swapEdges. Complete behavior remains MISMATCH because Rugra's inline-owned BlockGraph cannot install the oracle's stable child parent pointer; packed block marshal IDs differ from the locked oracle; and BlockCopy printRaw/printRawImpliedGoto/printTree/emit delegation is not implemented equivalently. Parent/print/marshal differences are deliberately not normalized or falsely observed and remain bound to BLOCK-ADDGRAPH-SEMANTICS-0001/BLOCKSTRUCT-IDENTIFY-BOUNDARY-0001/BLOCK-BUILDCOPY-MIRROR-0001. Non-Basic structured sources with non-default copied state, BlockCopy swapEdges/negateCondition, ActionBlockStructure through Action::perform count state, non-end/renumber/overflow insertion branches, MULTIEQUAL caller repair, textual/tree encoding paths, null/expired references, self-loop remap/removal, and the full structuring consumer closure remain UNTESTED or known residuals as detailed below.

analysis_options.prestate: All observed source indices, visit counts, numdesc values, raw flags, immediate dominators, edge insertion order, labels, reciprocal indices, inserted op creation times/opcodes, and empty BlockBasic op state are explicitly initialized. Original copymap is null except the destination prefix sentinels. The parallel-edge source has exactly two outgoing edges before swapEdges, satisfying its legal precondition.
analysis_options.observation: One envelope plus fixed-order graph/source/copy/insert/removal records. Every covered copy node reports type/index/raw flags/visit/numdesc/idom, complete ordered in/out vectors as peer:reverse_index:label, reciprocal validity, source copymap where defined, and BlockCopy subBlock identity. The live case reports exit-self, first/last op tokens, isComplex, and split-point delegation before and after source mutation. The insert case reports exact op list/time/order/parent, lastOp, raw block flags and SWITCH_OUT. The parallel-removal case reports explicit local slots, peer/reverse slot/label on both halves, raw source flags, and reciprocal validity before swap, after swap, and after deletion.
analysis_options.normalization: Only raw pointer/Arc identity and opaque PcodeOp token identity are replaced by creation-order names. No block order, edge order, label, reverse slot, state field, delegate result, or output line is sorted, removed, or rewritten.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; all construction and iteration order is fixed
analysis_options.excluded_undefined_input: buildCopy invoked with source and destination as the same graph is excluded: the locked C++ body appends into the vector it is iterating and provides no supported alias guard

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: buildCopy mutates the destination graph by appending live BlockCopy objects and mutates every source FlowBlock copymap; source edge/state vectors remain shared originals and BlockCopy keeps a strong live source alias. BlockBasic::insert writes the exact graph-owned block identity into each PcodeOp parent and mutates order/flags. swapEdges mutates both source slots and destination reverse indices; removeEdge removes one exact bilateral edge. Rust uses the same Arc allocations through trait dispatch and records all listed mutations.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: The source list is traversed exactly begin-to-end once to create all copies; after all source copymaps exist, only destination slots [startsize,end) are traversed in order for endpoint/idom remap. Incoming and outgoing vectors retain their original slot order and prefix nodes are never revisited. End insertion appends in call order. removeEdge scans destination incoming slots from zero and stops at the first source-identity match; each half-delete slides survivors left in original order while repairing their reciprocal slots.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: startsize is captured once before appending; every BlockCopy visitcount starts at constructor value zero while index/numdesc/flags are copied; destination graph index is updated by addBlock as the running minimum; SWITCH_OUT is added only when copied outgoing length is strictly greater than two. End insertion derives each order from the preceding order and a 0x01000000 end gap, with parent set before list insertion; BRANCHIND then adds SWITCH_OUT. swapEdges toggles FLIP_PATH once; removeEdge captures the reciprocal slot before either half is slid.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No sort, hash walk, deduplication, or index-as-vector-slot lookup occurs. Copy mapping uses source object identity through copymap; labels and reciprocal indices are copied verbatim, including the source-list/incoming-order disagreement in incoming_order_6_2. Parallel removal compares destination incoming peer identity only, then trusts that matched edge's reverse_index to select the exact source half; it never independently chooses the first source outgoing peer match.
